name: Gitea
description: Gitea / Forgejo / Codeberg repo host channel. Connection stub used by gitea-channel and any future Gitea-aware extension.
long_description:
Channel stub that represents the Gitea integration surface. Works with gitea.com forks, self-hosted Gitea, Forgejo, and Codeberg. Other extensions declare it as a dependency to signal they need an authenticated Gitea client.

Configuration (host + Personal Access Token) is held by the gitea-channel extension because it owns the runtime that uses it.
author: Kernl
